title: Operate PageSpec
description: Machine contract for a page composed from templates/sections. Closed everywhere (additionalProperties:false). Per-section content/motion branches are generated from sections/*.json (verify_all.py checks they are in sync). Structural rules (template cross-reference, order, graph, budgets, asset registry) live in schema/semantic_validate.py. Required `mode` (clone | generation) selects the generation-safety context.

mode.description: clone = reference reconstruction of the Operate site (may reference clone-only and blocked-for-generation assets and the source copy). generation = original page for any other property: only generation-safe asset roles; Operate branding, integration logos/third-party marks, real or source-demo people, product screenshots/media, source copy and real/live URLs are rejected by the GENERATION_MODE_BRAND / _INTEGRATION_LOGO / _PERSON / _SCREENSHOT / _COPY / _URL rules.
